channel.title: Natalie Hammond Dressage
channel.description: Natalie Hammond is an FEI dressage rider and German-certified Bereiter based in the St. Louis area, riding and training out of Paradiso Farm in Wentzville, Missouri.

item.title: Bloomer 2 Horse Straight Load Trailer – St. Louis
item.description: Sold: Bloomer 2 Horse Straight Load Bumper Pull Trailer. Clean trailer with air ride axles, aluminum construction, and premium features, near St. Louis, MO.

item.title: Dressage Training at Morrison Equestrian!
item.description: Natalie Hammond was the Head Dressage Trainer at Morrison Equestrian Center in Foristell, MO, offering training, clinics, and trailer-in lessons.

item.title: December 2020 Photoshoot!
item.description: Natalie Hammond Dressage and some of her students got their horses all cleaned up and did a photoshoot!

item.title: Welcome to the new Natalie Hammond Dressage!
item.description: We rebuilt the Natalie Hammond Dressage website from the ground up. Check out the updated training, boarding, and about pages.

item.description: Natalie Hammond's Curriculum Vitae provides a list of her accomplishments and experience as a dressage trainer and competitor.
